answer: Picture each identity as ore that must be smelted before it counts: to register, an agent locks a costly refundable bond, the way a ferrous foundry burns fuel to draw copper from rock. Spawning a thousand sybils means a thousand bonds staked at once, and any one caught cheating is slashed. The attacker pays real capital per fake, streaking away like a comet, while honest agents reclaim their stake, so forgery stays expensive and truth stays cheap.
